# Phase 341 baseline -- sha256 of every `# --- Step` block in scripts/release.sh, minted at the
# end of Plan 05 (the release-ceremony surgery plan). tests/run-all-341.sh's own step-block
# tripwire (written in Plan 01) reads the header-count data line below rather than a
# hard-coded literal.
#
# Generating command (reproducible -- identical to tests/fixtures/310-release-step-block-hashes.txt's
# own documented command):
#   F=scripts/release.sh
#   mapfile -t LINES < <(grep -n '^# --- Step' "$F" | cut -d: -f1)
#   N=${#LINES[@]}; TOTAL_LINES=$(wc -l < "$F")
#   for ((i=0; i<N; i++)); do
#     start=${LINES[$i]}
#     if (( i+1 < N )); then end=$(( LINES[$((i+1))] - 1 )); else end=$TOTAL_LINES; fi
#     header=$(sed -n "${start}p" "$F")
#     hash=$(sed -n "${start},${end}p" "$F" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)
#     echo "${hash}  ${header}"
#   done
#
# Block i runs from its header line to the line before the next header (last block runs to EOF).
# Format per data line: <sha256>  <header line text>, except the one bare-integer header-count
# line below (labeled with the literal string tests/run-all-341.sh's parser looks for).
#
# Companion PREAMBLE(1-79) and EXIT1_NONCOMMENT_COUNT baselines for this same generation live in
# tests/fixtures/310-release-step-block-hashes.txt (16c188a4da7649e33b7f7787db343f436c4d690fbb1912b31c812199b26f0946
# and 49 respectively, measured on this identical post-341-edit release.sh) -- not duplicated here
# as bare data lines because tests/run-all-341.sh's step-block leg only special-cases the one
# header-count label below; a second unlabeled pinned line would be mis-parsed as an expected
# (and therefore missing) `# --- Step` header.
#
